text:
kevin: hey team, just opened my first PR to cli-tools (https://github.com/redwood/cli-tools/pull/13). couple newbie q's: 1) do we branch off main or use a dev branch? 2) what's the team's stance on small dependency bumps in the same PR as feature changes? 3) any preferred commit/PR template quirks I should follow?

maya: welcome Kevin! :wave: short answers: branch off main for single-author small work. we avoid mixing deps + feature in the same PR; split them so security reviews can look at deps separately.

lin: exact policy: feature PRs should not include unrelated package upgrades. if a dependency must be bumped for the feature to work, include an explicit "why" in the PR body and prefer a separate packaging PR if possible. For branching use feat/<ticket>-desc.

kevin: makes sense. about commit messages — any specific linting or CI checks?

zoe: we use conventional commit style and a short body explaining why. CI also parses the ticket id from the PR body for release notes. Example: 

"feat(cli): add `sync` command (ENG-214)"

"Why: needed to avoid manual node restarts in infra"

We run `pre-commit` and `make format` in CI. If pre-commit fails locally, run `pre-commit run --all-files` before pushing.

review-bot: review-bot: FYI — New repo rule: no mixed deps+code PRs. Please split.

kevin: good to know. my PR accidentally included a small vendor/ dir because I ran `make build`. how do I remove vendor without losing my code changes?

maya: drop vendor from git index and add to .gitignore, then force-push cleaned branch. e.g.: 
```bash
git rm -r --cached vendor || true
echo "vendor/" >> .gitignore
git add .gitignore
git add path/to/changed/files
git commit -m "feat(cli): add sync command (ENG-214)"
git push --force
```

lin: also include a "Reviewer checklist" in the PR: how to run the feature locally, expected output, and any performance notes. That gets reviewers through faster.

kevin: thanks. how many reviewers do I need? and any prefered labeling?

zoe: one approval from CODEOWNERS path + one peer is standard. add labels: needs-review, size/XS/S/M etc. We use size/* to route to reviewers. If it touches infra or security, add needs-security-review.

kevin: CI shows a lint error in a generated file — `gofmt` diff. I don't want to commit generated files — what should I do?

maya: regenerate locally to confirm, then reset generated files from main before committing: `git checkout origin/main -- gen/**` and stage only source files. CI will regenerate.

lin: small extra: if your PR includes tests, mark them with the test tag in PR body. Also, if you want a quick pair-review, ping @maya or drop a "pair-review" label and sched a 15-min slot. We often do quick screens in #devex.

kevin: perfect — i'll split the dep bump into a separate PR, remove vendor, run pre-commit, add the Reviewer checklist and tag CODEOWNERS. will ping when CI is green. thanks a ton :pray:
